# Fjordwire Docs

> Everything a developer needs to integrate Fjordwire payments.

Fjordwire is a Norwegian payments API. This file is what we published for agents
before we knew there was anything better to publish.

## Guides

- [Quickstart](https://fjordwire.no/quickstart): Take your first payment in five minutes
- [Authentication](https://fjordwire.no/auth): API keys, rotation, and scopes
- [Webhooks](https://fjordwire.no/webhooks): Receive settlement events

## Reference

- [HTTP API](https://fjordwire.no/api)
- [Error codes](https://fjordwire.no/errors): Every code we return, and what to do about it

## Optional

- [Partner SDK](https://partner-sdk.example/fjordwire): Maintained by a partner, not by us
